YOUR HOME IN THE VALLEY

01 / THE COTTAGE

Come for the view.
Stay for the feeling.

Some places invite you to do less. Nestled in Kullu, Thakur Cottage is your base for unhurried mornings, mountain air and days that unfold at your own pace.

Our Airbnb-style approach brings together the ease of a hotel and the feeling of a home. Fifty rooms, one room category, and a welcoming space for two to three guests in each.
